Despite several half-chances and tactical adjustments, both defenses held firm, and the teams went into the halftime break with the deadlock still unbroken. Second Half Explosion The second half saw a complete shift in momentum as the game burst into life almost immediately after the restart. In the 53rd minute, Lucas Torreira delivered a pinpoint assist to find Victor Osimhen , who made no mistake in putting Galatasaray ahead. However, the joy for the home fans was short-lived. Besiktas responded with incredible speed; first, Alexandros Kyziridis leveled the score in the 59th minute following a setup by Fredy , and just two minutes later, Jesus Ramirez stunned the stadium by finding the net to turn the game on its head. Drama and Redemption in the Closing Stages The narrative took another dramatic twist in the 70th minute when Alexandros Kyziridis , who had earlier scored the equalizer, was shown a straight red card. This left the visitors to defend their lead with ten men amidst heavy protests from the coaching staff. Galatasaray pushed forward relentlessly, introducing fresh legs like Ilkay Gundogan and Mario Lemina to exploit the advantage. The pressure finally told in the 90th minute when Gabriel Sara provided the cross for Victor Osimhen to head home his second of the night, securing a hard-fought draw after eight minutes of stoppage time.
